title: Sullivan & Cromwell and OpenAI develop agreement review tool
excerpt: Agreement Analyzer uses ChatGPT Enterprise to identify issues in draft legal agreements.
bodyHtml:
In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an artificial intelligence tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement, according to a publication from October 15, 2026. The application integrates Sullivan & Cromwell workflows, curated firm precedents, negotiating playbooks, and ChatGPT Enterprise.

Sullivan & Cromwell partner John Savva developed Agreement Analyzer as a single-user proof of concept built with Codex. He then collaborated with OpenAI on improving the quality of outputs, enhancing efficiency through parallel processing and transforming the application into a tool that could be used by multiple lawyers at the same time.

The tool performs multiple review cycles from different perspectives, synthesizes the outputs, helps identify potential issues and returns a memorandum and proposed tracked changes for a lawyer to review, adapt or reject. Sullivan & Cromwell is continuing to explore tools shaped around specific legal tasks.
